messages:
marta: Deploy-bot paused the promotion for payments service — seeing a chart-version skew across regions, holding canary until we agree on next steps. pinging release owners.

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] Promotion halted: chart version mismatch detected.
- service: payments
- eu-west: v1.13.0 (promoted)
- us-east: v1.11.9 (still on previous)
- reason: preflight values-schema check failed in us-east, promotion skipped

jamie: @marta thanks — is this coming from the staggered-promotion queue or a manual roll? any image errors?

marta: Staggered promotion. no ImagePullBackOff. helm preflight returned schema validation failure in us-east, so deploy-bot skipped the promotion there.

owen: If it's values-schema, we can either pin eu-west back to v1.12.0 temporarily or trigger a rollback in eu-west. Pin keeps traffic stable while we patch v1.13.0. Which do we prefer?

sanjay: my +1 is to pin eu-west for 1h and run a quick validation job in us-east. :thumbsup: :clock1:

infra-oncall: We can open a manual rollback window in ~10m if you decide rollback. Also need to know release_note delta — what's changed that could affect parity? @jamie

jamie: Release note snippet: 
```
- default job concurrency bumped: 5 -> 10
  (may increase DB connections under bursty loads)
```
This is the only config-affecting change in v1.13.0.

marta: @deploy-bot list affected namespaces and helm history for payments in us-east so we can decide pin vs rollback.

deploy-bot: Affected namespaces: payments-prod, payments-staging.
Helm history (payments, us-east): REV 45 -> v1.11.9 (current).
Helm history (payments, eu-west): REV 46 -> v1.13.0 (promoted).

owen: I'll run the validation job in us-east: `kubectl -n payments run canary-schema-check --image=ci/payment-check:latest --restart=Never -- /bin/sh -c "./validate-schema.sh"` — will post results here in ~5m.

marta: Proposed plan: 1) pin eu-west back to chart v1.12.0 for 30m (safety window), 2) run validation job in us-east, 3) if validation passes, patch v1.13.0 to revert the concurrency default and re-promote. I'll update release notes and open a follow-up thread for the patch rollout. :white_check_mark:

jamie: ack — I'm opening a patch branch now to revert the default concurrency and will attach test run logs.

deploy-bot: Promotion hold recorded (initiator: marta). Pin request created for eu-west (service: payments, target: v1.12.0). To manually unpin: `/deploybot unpin payments eu-west`.

marta: thanks everyone — I'll execute the pin and post the pin confirmation when done.
